timezoneNote: Launch windows in U.S. Eastern Time unless stated. Displayed to visitors in Europe/Stockholm as well.

events.window: Launched 13 Nov 17:47 ET (22:47 UTC); ship catch attempt planned 14 Nov ~21:17 UTC
events.title: Starship Flight 15
events.detail: Starbase, Texas. Launched 13 Nov 2026; Super Heavy booster catch was aborted. Ship (S42) with 26 Starlink V3 satellites is in orbit, with the first-ever ship return-to-launch-site catch attempt planned about 22.5 hours after liftoff (14 Nov, ~21:17 UTC).

events.title: U.S. Thanksgiving — equity markets closed
events.detail: Nasdaq closed. Hyperliquid xyz:SPCX continues to trade; oracle on internal pricing for the U.S. holiday (overnight session also shut Nov 25 per trade.xyz holiday schedule).

events.title: Next share unlock: end of the 180-day IPO lock-up
events.detail: Up to 797.6 million remaining shares in the 180-day lock-up group become eligible on 8 Dec 2026 (the 180th day after the 11 Jun 2026 prospectus; a Tuesday session). This is the larger of the two remainder sizes in the 424(b)(4), used because the August $175.50 early-release test does not appear to have been met (inferred from public closing prices; SpaceX has not filed a confirmation). See the Share unlock schedule for the full calendar, sources, and later 2027 releases.

events.title: Starship Flight 16 — first from Florida (tentative)
events.detail: Public reporting points to a mid-December target, possibly Dec 10, from LC-39A at Kennedy Space Center — the first Starship launch from Florida. Date not confirmed by SpaceX in a formal advisory as of 11 Nov.

events.title: Q4 2026 / FY2026 results (estimated)
events.detail: TipRanks/earnings calendars estimate around 25 Feb 2027. SpaceX has not confirmed the date. Separately, the prospectus releases up to 351.9 million extended-group shares on the second full trading day after those results — that unlock date is therefore also unset. See the Share unlock schedule.

events.title: Mesh Optical merger shares — earliest Rule 144 date
events.detail: About 3.8 million unregistered shares issued Jul 6, 2026; six-month holding period ends around Jan 6, 2027.

events.title: Cursor merger shares — earliest Rule 144 trading day
events.detail: ~391.0 million shares issued Aug 14, 2026. Six-month holding ends Feb 14, 2027 (Sunday); Feb 15 is Presidents' Day; first trading day Feb 16. A separate lock-up may still apply; terms not fully public.

events.title: Extended lock-up: 10% scheduled release
events.detail: 176 million shares from the extended IPO lock-up group (holders other than Musk, including most of Gwynne Shotwell’s and the CFO’s holdings).

events.title: Elon Musk 366-day IPO lock-up ends
events.detail: 849.5M Class A and 3.917B Class B (must convert to Class A before sale), plus a 20% extended-group slice (~351.9M) also scheduled for this date. Musk’s unvested CEO / AI performance awards remain subject to separate vesting (market-cap and operational milestones, including a Mars colony and off-Earth compute).

events.title: EchoStar spectrum closing — share issuance (expected)
events.detail: Up to 261,792,453 Class A shares to be issued to EchoStar at the spectrum closing, expected Nov 30, 2027 (per FloatCap / 10-Q discussion of fully diluted shares).

risks.title: Capex and free cash flow
risks.detail: SI capex is enormous: $16.4B in Q3, with Q4 guided at $35–40B. Street FY2026 FCF consensus is about −$56.6B. The AI build has to keep converting into contracted revenue.

risks.title: Q1 2027 guidance execution
risks.detail: A jump from $14.6B in Q3 to $33–37B in Q1 2027 depends on cloud-services agreements and compute actually coming online. Misses would likely re-rate the stock.

risks.title: Lock-up supply
risks.detail: 797.6M shares on 8 Dec 2026, then staged extended-group and Musk unlocks through mid-2027. Tradable float is still only about a third of shares outstanding.

risks.title: Power, cooling, and supply chain
risks.detail: Musk has flagged power, cooling and electrical infrastructure as binding constraints. The Texas gas-plant / data-center plans and the 100 GW/year solar equipment order are part of the answer — and also new execution risks.

risks.title: Key-person and control
risks.detail: Musk held about 82% of voting power at the IPO (Class B is 10 votes). A special committee is evaluating a possible combination with Tesla; no terms have been disclosed.

risks.title: Starship operationalization
risks.detail: Flight 15 is the first planned double catch and another V3 deployment. Cadence, reuse, and FAA licensing remain operational and regulatory risks.

risks.title: Valuation and multiples
risks.detail: At ~$1.9T equity value the stock already discounts a very large SI ramp. EV / FY2026 street sales is extremely high; the bull case needs FY2027+ compute revenue to show up.

risks.title: Customer and regulatory concentration
risks.detail: SI revenue is currently more cloud-rental (Anthropic, Google, Reflection and others have been named in press) than in-house models. Starlink Mobile and aviation depend on spectrum, aviation authorities, and national regulators (India still a watch item).
